releaseNotes: v1.3.1 -- Fixed a bug in the doorbell driver: it declares the PushableButton capability but never implemented the push() command, so clicking Push on the Commands tab (or any app/rule calling it) threw a MissingMethodException. Also fixed supportedFeatures under-reporting a doorbell's light -- doorbells report it under a different ability key (supportDoorbellLight) than cameras do (supportFLswitch); now checks both. Confirmed supportAiPackage as the real package-detection field name against real doorbell hardware. Also includes v1.3.0 (auto-discovery on first open, new supportedFeatures attribute from Reolink's GetAbility API, clarified battery-device docs).
author: jdthomas24
